sources: NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust Architecture (2020) — tenets, PE/PA/PEP, policy engine
Google BeyondCorp papers (2014+) — device/user trust, no network perimeter
CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model 2.0 (2023) — pillars: identity, device, network, application, data
notes: Тема архитектурно-концептуальная, не версионируется по релизам ПО; принципы (never trust always verify, микросегментация, least privilege, continuous verification) устойчивы.
